Subject: Customer huddle request — MetalWorks (late-stage, US ops)

Lisa —

Congrats on getting to final procurement rounds — excited to see MetalWorks moving forward. As we get toward contract sign, our legal/procurement teams often want to speak with a peer at a similar scale who has gone through a production rollout.

Samir mentioned you might be open to a short "customer huddle": a 30–40 minute call where a couple of your stakeholders (ops/procurement/engineering) can hear directly from a Redwood customer who recently completed an on-prem + Dedicated rollout in manufacturing operations. The goal is a candid discussion on deployment timeline, observable latency/cost tradeoffs, and change management lessons.

Proposed ask: could we schedule a 30–40 minute huddle next week (Aug 24–26)? We can bring one engineering lead from our peer reference (US-based) and limit the agenda to: 1) deployment anatomy, 2) performance and tuning, 3) contractual and support expectations.

If you're open, please confirm who on your side would attend (ops lead + procurement is perfect) and two 1-hour windows that work. We'll keep it concise and off-the-record unless you want us to record.

Thanks — appreciate it.

—Markus
Markus Klein
